Fungible grouped count for the account model's compatible bird-house log input, excluding Magic logs because that stack has its own model key. Do not use this aggregate where an action requires a specific log tier; pyre, treated, crate, lantern, and unrelated log IDs are excluded.
Fungible low-tier bird-house seed group: ten seeds per bird house. Aggregate only these four herb-seed IDs; do not include seed-vault/interface copies.

Fungible higher-tier bird-house seed group: five seeds per bird house. This is the live herb-seed range above Harralander, including Huasca; low-tier seeds are kept in the separate group to preserve the ten-versus-five consumption rate.
